metaTitle: Plotmio | Visual Editor for Ren’Py Projects
metaDescription: Map Ren’Py labels, choices and jumps across your .rpy files. Explore an interactive project canvas, edit scenes, and review your export with Plotmio.
metaOgDescription: Bring an existing Ren’Py project onto one canvas. Follow labels, choices and connections, edit together, and export normalized .rpy files.
metaTwitterDescription: See how labels, choices and jumps connect across your Ren’Py project. Explore Plotmio’s interactive canvas demo.
schemaDescription: Plotmio is a visual editor for existing Ren’Py projects. It maps .rpy files, labels, choices and connections on one canvas.
stageLabel: Explore Plotmio on an interactive project canvas
heroLead: Bring your .rpy files onto one canvas. Follow labels, choices and connections, edit with your team, and review your export.
featureEyebrow: From files to the whole story
featureTitle: A clearer view of your existing project.
feature1Body: File and label frames keep the structure of your project visible on one canvas.
feature2Body: Choices, jumps and calls become connections you can trace across the story.
feature3Body: Review a normalized .rpy export. Editor layout and collaboration data stay out of the files.
howTitle: Start with the project you already have.
step1Body: Select the Ren’Py project root that contains game. Plotmio reads .rpy text and an asset-name catalog.
step2Body: Navigate labels and branches on the canvas, then work with collaborators in the same project.
step3Body: Export normalized scripts and write them back only after reviewing the changed files. Start with a copy of your project.
filesBody: To save a project, Plotmio uploads .rpy text and a catalog of asset names and paths. Images, audio and video stay on your computer. Export uses normalized formatting, so it is not a byte-for-byte round trip.
faq1Question: Can I open an existing Ren’Py project?
faq1Answer: Yes. Choose the project root and Plotmio imports the .rpy files inside game.
faq2Question: Do I need an account to try Plotmio?
faq2Answer: No account is needed for the interactive demo. Sign in to save your own project or collaborate.
faq3Question: Does Plotmio preserve my exact .rpy formatting?
faq3Answer: Export uses normalized formatting. Review generated files before writing them into your project.
faq4Question: Does Plotmio run my Ren’Py game?
faq4Answer: Plotmio maps and edits project structure; run and test the game in Ren’Py. Dynamic references and arbitrary Python may remain unresolved.
faq5Question: Which browser do I need to import a local project?
faq5Answer: Local folder access currently requires a Chromium browser, such as Chrome or Edge, and your explicit permission.
finalTitle: See your story from a different angle.
finalBody: Open a project you already know and find connections that are hard to see in a file list.
footerTagline: An independent open-source tool for Ren’Py creators.
